fields.description:
Cut CI tickets-store transfer cost across both checkout mechanisms. Measured evidence in session_log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 and epic comments: recurring actions/checkout full checkout 1.04 GiB / 59 s versus blob:none 68.7 MiB / 14.3 s; Gerrit verify-identity full tickets fetch 6.73 minutes, with local full 1.4 GB / 66.2 s versus blob:none 22 MB / 3.6 s and 83 MB / 8.6 s after worktree materialization. These recorded baselines do not replace the runtime guards below.

## Scope and mechanisms
Add the documented actions/checkout v7 filter input (published action.yml input name filter, available since v4.1.0) while retaining fetch-depth: 0 and existing credentials/ref settings in .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml, .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml, and .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml. These all-history checkouts currently fetch tickets before the later mount step.

A subsequent plain git fetch origin +tickets must inherit the named remote filter. Config presence is insufficient because Git records partialclonefilter even when a server ignores it. Prove actual protocol negotiation and missing-object behavior with a real server.

In .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml both tickets fetches use a direct URL, so named-remote inheritance does not apply. Add --filter=blob:none explicitly to the depth-1 require-ticket fetch and the full-history verify-identity fetch, preserving their different depth semantics. blob:none retains the complete commit graph required by merge-base and era scoping; depth remains forbidden on the identity fetch.

## Real-Git fixture and protocol oracle
Start git daemon as a localhost subprocess with --export-all and --enable=upload-pack. Point GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL at a temporary global config containing uploadpack.allowFilter=true and set GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 in the daemon environment, so the daemon and spawned upload-pack process inherit filter support. Do not rely on repository-local uploadpack.allowFilter, which git daemon ignores for security, and do not use a file URL. Reserve a loopback port and poll the socket with a bounded deadline.

Before writing tests, a Git 2.55 probe observed client filter packets as packet: fetch> filter blob:none for git fetch and packet: clone> filter blob:none for clone. Tests must not hard-code the actor label. Require both: a server capability packet advertising filter, and a client-to-server packet matching packet: followed by any non-space actor ending in >, then exact content filter blob:none. Also assert the known tickets blob is reported missing before materialization.

The fixture commits an incompressible historical blob larger than 140 MiB, then removes it and leaves a small tickets tip. After server-side gc, a full all-history fetch must exceed 131072 KiB while blob:none must remain below 102400 KiB before worktree materialization and below 131072 KiB after materializing only the small tip. Execute the actual named workflow run blocks against these repos so a broken numeric comparison or KiB parse fails. Use distinct test names pre_materialization_pack_guard and post_materialization_pack_guard.

Capture packet traces for plain named-origin inheritance, direct URL with --depth=1 --filter=blob:none, and direct URL full-history with --filter=blob:none. Each must satisfy the capability/request regex and missing-blob oracle.

Never use filter: tree:0: measured 3.57 GiB across 2,255 promisor packs. git worktree add uses unpack-trees -u/check_updates and batch-prefetches missing promisor blobs, unlike the read-tree plus checkout-index footgun in tests/unit/test_snapshot_blobless_747f.py. A real-Git E2E must materialize tickets, create independent local and remote changes, fetch/merge with the B3 ours driver, retain all expected events, and push successfully.

## Production guardrails
- Standalone verify-identity declares REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400. Immediately after actions/checkout, parse size-pack from git count-objects -v and fail above that limit.
- Gerrit verify-identity declares REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072. After filtered tickets fetch and worktree materialization, fail above that limit; this runs on the patchset and proves GitHub honored the direct filter.
- In both verify-identity jobs, snapshot exact git count-objects -v after materialization, run rebar verify-identity, snapshot again, and fail if any line differs. Materialization may fetch tip blobs; identity scanning must add no objects or packs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each target actions/checkout@v7 step sets filter: blob:none. Tier: parsed workflow. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k checkout_filter -v.
- [ ] Each target actions/checkout@v7 step retains fetch-depth: 0 and its prior credential/ref inputs. Tier: parsed workflow. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k checkout_preserves_inputs -v.
- [ ] Gerrit require-ticket passes --filter=blob:none and retains --depth=1. Tier: parsed workflow. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k require_ticket_fetch -v.
- [ ] Gerrit verify-identity passes --filter=blob:none and has no depth option. Tier: parsed workflow. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k identity_fetch -v.
- [ ] Production size guards parse size-pack from git count-objects -v and use the declared 102400 KiB and 131072 KiB limits. Tier: executable workflow contract. Proving command: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k pack_guard_contract -v.
- [ ] Executing the actual pre-materialization guard against real Git rejects an unfiltered all-history pack above 131072 KiB and accepts blobless below 102400 KiB. Tier: real-Git contrast. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k pre_materialization_pack_guard -v.
- [ ] Executing the actual post-materialization guard accepts the blobless small tickets tip below 131072 KiB. Tier: real-Git boundary. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k post_materialization_pack_guard -v.
- [ ] Plain named-origin fetch negotiates filter capability, sends exact filter blob:none in a client request packet, and leaves a known tickets blob missing before materialization. Tier: real Git protocol. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k named_origin_filter -v.
- [ ] Depth-1 direct URL fetch negotiates filter capability, sends filter blob:none, and leaves the known blob missing. Tier: real Git protocol. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k direct_depth_filter -v.
- [ ] Full-history direct URL fetch negotiates filter capability, sends filter blob:none, and leaves the known blob missing. Tier: real Git protocol. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k direct_full_filter -v.
- [ ] A blobless tickets worktree reconverges independent local and remote changes with the configured ours driver, retains every expected event, and pushes the merged result. Tier: real-Git end to end. Proving command: pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k reconverges -v.
- [ ] Exact git count-objects -v output is identical immediately before and after rebar verify-identity in standalone CI. Tier: executable workflow plus real-Git integration. Proving commands: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k standalone_no_promisor -v and pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k standalone_identity_no_promisor -v.
- [ ] Exact git count-objects -v output is identical immediately before and after rebar verify-identity in Gerrit CI. Tier: executable workflow plus real-Git integration. Proving commands: pytest tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py -k gerrit_no_promisor -v and pytest tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py -k gerrit_identity_no_promisor -v.

## Files and rollback
Files: .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml; .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml; .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml; .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml; tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py; tests/integration/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone.py.

Rollback is one Gerrit revert restoring prior full fetches and removing paired guards. Do not disable only a failing size guard: a threshold trip means the cost regression is real until the filter/server path is repaired or the whole optimization is reverted.

Scope: M. Depends on closed B3 040e-3f0c-ae86-4212 and closed B6 3036-cb14-86b5-44a3.
